decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds directly on the firm's in-house automation and machining application know-how and fits its stated push toward smarter automation, so it can learn from early results and refine the product.
The dual-table loading system is a close extension of the firm's existing machine and accessory portfolio, with high knowledge relatedness and low cost to keep while customer feedback is absorbed.

The flagship dispensing machine draws on the firm's established dispensing and machine-building expertise and won a Red Dot award, which validates it and justifies further investment in in-house development.
